checkpoints.description: [2/4] Input and snapshot integrity: WorldConfig now requires integer width/height/day_length and finite numeric fields, so NaN, infinity, strings and 1.5-tile worlds fail at construction instead of deep in world/engine code; Engine.spawn refuses non-finite/negative energy and non-integer coordinates; save loading verifies layer lengths, terrain/food/temperature/phase ranges, unique cids, in-bounds land positions, species references, sequential registry ids, ancestors, birth ticks, fossil traces/events and capacity; dump_text refuses NaN (save_to turns it into a SaveError) and a directory .bak is treated as unusable. 12 new tests; 123/123 in 2.5s; long-run save/load hash equal with 19 species and 29 events; 4/4 gates; checklists: passed.

[3/4] Honest determinism and statistics: snapshot_hash now covers the seed, config, raw RNG state, terrain, season phases, food, temperature, every species record, the registry distance and the full fossil record, so an RNG-only or climate-only divergence is visible (about 1 ms per call, on demand only); species_counts and trait_means ignore dead creatures as their docstrings already promised. 2 new tests (four mutation probes plus a dead-population check); 125/125 in 2.4s; same-seed full-state hash and save/load replay still exact; 4/4 gates; checklists: passed.

[4/4] Release 1.0.3: README documents live neighbour bookkeeping, the guaranteed single founder species, full-state determinism hashing, treated snapshots and the 125-test tally; ADR-009 records the audit, decisions, costs and consequences; version bumped in __init__ and pyproject; verified primordia 1.0.3, friendly exit 2 on an invalid world, exact save/load replay through tick 500, 125/125 tests and 4/4 gates; checklists: passed.

[1/5] movement: never invent a step on a zero-delta axis when the direct tile is water (creatures currently sidestep away from the target); [2/5] round-trip: spawn normalizes energy to float so integer energy keeps the snapshot hash across save/load, and saves carry the species registry distance (0.18 default for old files); [3/5] integrity: shocks refuse non-whole coordinates, radius and count plus non-numeric shares, and snapshot verification refuses impossible ages, fossil dates and event ancestors; [4/5] release 1.0.4 with README, ADR-010 and the test tally; [5/5] strict gates, commits and close.

impact_assessment.why: The fourth full-code audit found defects past 1.0.3: a blocked direct step makes a creature sidestep on an axis it does not need to move along; spawn(energy=45) stores an int so the snapshot hash changes after a save/load; a custom species threshold is lost by saves; shock API misuse raises TypeError instead of a readable ValueError; and snapshots with negative ages or impossible fossil dates are trusted.
impact_assessment.benefits: Creatures stay on the target line when the direct tile is water; the save/load replay contract holds for integer energy and custom thresholds; operator mistakes get readable ValueErrors; malformed snapshots are refused instead of rendering nonsense.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: movement and shock validation change edge-input behaviour, and saves gain an optional distance field (old saves still load at 0.18); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: fixed-seed histories change where a creature used to sidestep, and a previously loadable malformed snapshot may now be refused; determinism stays exact for valid saves.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first test per defect; full suite plus a 500-tick save/load hash replay after each milestone; keep the new save field optional with a documented default; regenerate the map, record checklists and commit each milestone alone.

checkpoints.description: [1/5] Movement fixed: a creature whose direct tile toward a target is water no longer invents a step on an axis with a zero delta (it used to sidestep, and a second stride could carry it to (3,5) or (5,3)); steps now come only from nonzero deltas, larger axis first, unchanged on open ground. 1 new failing-first test covers both axes; 126/126 tests in 2.5s; 4/4 gates; checklists: passed.

[2/5] Round trip fixed: Engine.spawn stores energy as a float, so spawn(..., energy=45) no longer changes the snapshot hash after a save/load; SpeciesRegistry normalizes its threshold to a float, and a save now carries species_distance, with older files defaulting to 0.18 and non-finite or negative thresholds refused as corrupt. 3 new failing-first tests (integer energy hash, custom threshold, old-save default); 129/129 tests in 2.4s; 4/4 gates; checklists: passed.

[3/5] Integrity fixed: shocks now reject non-whole x/y/radius/count and non-numeric or boolean shares with a readable ValueError (floats used to reach range() as TypeError; string shares failed comparisons); snapshot verification refuses ages outside [0, tick], sighting windows where first_seen is after last_seen or last_seen is in the future, extinction ticks beyond the snapshot and events with a future tick or an ancestor outside the lineage. 2 new failing-first tests with 6 shock sub-cases and 5 date sub-cases; 132/132 tests in 2.6s; 4/4 gates; checklists: passed.

[4/5] Release 1.0.4: README documents the blocked-step guarantee, the exact integer-energy and species-threshold round trips, the stricter snapshot dates and the 132-test tally; ADR-010 records the audit, decisions and consequences; version bumped in __init__ and pyproject; verified primordia 1.0.4, a 500-tick save/load replay at 108 creatures over 3 species with 2 events and an equal hash, 132/132 tests and 4/4 gates; checklists: passed.
[5/5] Delivery closed: the strict Phase 4 gate passed 4/4 and pushed the four audit commits (movement, round trips, integrity, release) to origin; 132/132 tests; checklists: passed.
Task 'task-primordia-audit-v4' completed successfully.

[1/5] God-mode interventions: add ice_age (climatic chill, food reduction, and thermophily-scaled stress) and radiation_burst (radiation-induced genetic mutation and instantaneous speciation); [2/5] Web Observatory God-mode integration and full lineage state payload; [3/5] Interactive phylogenetic tree visualization in the observatory; [4/5] Population and trait time-series SVG graphs; [5/5] Release 1.0.5 with ADR-011, documentation, regenerated map, and gate delivery.

impact_assessment.why: The user requested Web Observatory enhancements: interactive lineage/phylogenetic tree visualization, population/trait time-series graphs, and new god-mode interventions (ice age, radiation burst).
impact_assessment.benefits: Operators can simulate global climate shocks and mutagenic radiation bursts, inspect complete phylogenetic lineages, and monitor population and trait dynamics over time through rich offline SVG charts without third-party dependencies.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: existing save schemas and determinism contracts must remain 100% intact; dependency: zero external packages; concurrency: thread safety under observatory lock; state: shock reports and observatory state remain backward-compatible.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first unit tests for each new shock, strict input validation matching existing shocks, zero modifications to save schema format, all engine operations guarded under observatory thread lock, and full Phase 4 verification gates.

checkpoints.description: [1/5] New God-mode interventions: added ice_age (climatic chill, food reduction on land, and thermophily-scaled energy stress) and radiation_burst (deterministic sampling of living creatures, genome mutation, and instantaneous speciation recording); 2 new test classes and validation tests added; 134/134 tests pass; 4/4 gates; checklists: passed.

[2/5] Web Observatory God-mode integration & full lineage payload: wired /god/ice_age and /god/radiation_burst into HTTP handler and forms; included complete species lineage array in state_payload for phylogenetic tracing; 2 new tests; 136/136 tests pass; 4/4 gates; checklists: passed.

[3/5] Interactive phylogenetic tree visualization in the observatory: implemented build_phylogeny_svg cladogram renderer with lineage depth layout, orthogonal branch paths, color-coded living/extinct status nodes, and rich tooltips; embedded tree in observatory dashboard; 3 new tests; 139/139 tests pass; 4/4 gates; checklists: passed.
